home.heroTitle: Empowering Farmers with Advanced Digital Farming
home.heroSubtitle: DiFarm brings livestock records, animal health management, production tracking and connected monitoring into one digital platform. Built in Rwanda for the realities of livestock farming, DiFarm helps farmers move from reactive management to timely, informed action.
home.statFarmsDesc: Farmers currently using the platform on trial
home.aboutTitle: Building a smarter, safer future for livestock farming in Rwanda
home.aboutP1: DiFarm is a Rwandan AgriTech venture developing a digital livestock-management ecosystem for farmers who need better visibility over their animals and farm operations. The platform helps farmers create digital profiles for farms, users and livestock; record health, breeding, vaccination and treatment history; monitor production; and generate farm reports.
home.aboutP2: We are extending this digital foundation with a smart neck-worn device designed to collect livestock data such as body temperature, heart rate, movement and location. The goal is to connect what happens in the field with the animal's digital record so farmers can respond earlier to health issues, track animals more effectively and manage the farm using current information.
home.chipRecords: Keep all your cow records in one place
home.chipPerformance: Know how your farm is performing
home.solutionLivestockDesc: Register your animals and keep their health, vaccination, breeding, treatment and production records in one place.
home.solutionHealthDesc: Track animal health and farm production, record important activities, and understand how your livestock are performing over time.
home.solutionTrackingDesc: Know where your animals are and respond faster when livestock are lost, stolen or move outside the expected area.
home.solutionInsightsDesc: Connect livestock monitoring with the DiFarm platform to capture movement, temperature, heart rate and location data, then turn that information into useful alerts and reports.
home.processIntro: DiFarm turns everyday farm work into clear digital records—so you can track livestock, monitor health signals, and act on insights with confidence.
home.step1Title: Create the farm and animal records
home.step1Desc: Register the farm, users and livestock and build a digital profile for each animal.
home.step2Title: Record what happens on the farm
home.step2Desc: Capture production, vaccinations, treatments, breeding and other important livestock activities.
home.step3Title: Connect the animal to the platform
home.step3Desc: As the wearable becomes field-ready, it will collect selected health, movement and location data and transmit it to the DiFarm system.
home.step4Desc: Use the platform, alerts and reports to review what is happening and make better-timed farm decisions.
home.dashboardTitle: See the farm in one place
home.dashboardIntro: The DiFarm platform brings farm, user and livestock records into one workspace. Farmers can view animal profiles, manage health and production information, track farm activities and generate reports without relying on scattered notebooks.
home.collarTitle: A connected collar for the animal.
home.collarIntro: DiFarm is developing a neck-worn smart device designed to collect key livestock signals and connect them to the animal's digital record.
home.faqA1: DiFarm is a Rwandan AgriTech platform for digital livestock records, farm management, and connected monitoring to support better farm decisions.
home.faqA2: Farmers, cooperatives, veterinarians, development partners, and institutions that manage or support livestock operations.
home.faqQ3: Do I need the smart collar to start?
home.faqA3: No. You can start with digital farm, user, and animal records. The wearable adds live health, movement, and location data when it is field-ready.
home.faqQ4: Can I manage multiple farms or users?
home.faqA4: Yes. DiFarm supports farm and user management so teams can work from one shared workspace with the right access.
home.faqQ5: What data can I record today?
home.faqA5: Livestock profiles, production, vaccinations, treatments, breeding, inventory, and related farm activities—plus reports from that data.
home.faqQ6: How do I get started or book a demo?
home.faqA6: Use the contact form on this page, email difarm.rw@gmail.com, or call +250 786 461 607 and our team will guide you.
home.contactTitle: Get In touch with our team
home.contactIntro: Whether you are a farmer, cooperative, veterinary professional, development partner or institution, DiFarm is building the tools to make livestock data easier to capture, understand and act on.
home.footerBlurb: DiFarm is a Rwandan AgriTech venture building smarter livestock management through digital records, connected monitoring and data-driven decision support.
home.servicesIntro: Our services are tailored to help you manage every aspect of your farm, from cattle health to marketing and stock management.
